There are import and export buttons for the config, a question on first launch and a short tour. Existing 0.4.8 configs are merged automatically on update

New profile badges: developer, bug hunter (gold), Discord server booster (lambda) and supporter, which also shows how long they have supported us. Badges are bigger and glow. On each anniversary of joining HLSR, everyone gets a year badge, up to 10 years
New achievements for hours played, launches, days in a row, supporting the project and profile likes. Rare ones glow gold or purple, one glows like a rainbow. Some are secret
Profile: the SteamID and a link to the Steam profile moved to the “⋯” menu, the summary shows how many days in a row you have opened the launcher, and each earned achievement shows when you got it
Ghosting: “Check files” and “Repair game” work again. Missing files are downloaded one by one instead of the whole archive, and you can pick them with checkboxes
Link Discord to your HLSR profile: get a code in the launcher and send it with the /link command on the HLSR Discord server. Server boosters get the badge while they boost
Telegram now links by a code from the launcher too, with a confirmation in the bot. You can unlink it in the profile settings
Installer: a welcome step and a SmartScreen tip, clear antivirus and disk space errors. Uninstalling can remove games and settings in one go
A “Thank you for your support” window appears after a payment
The speedrun.com place of your pinned run now updates by itself
The Records tab now also shows recent runs verified on speedrun.com, up to 90 days old. World records get their own label
LiveSplit for Half-Life: fixed the error on “Activate” (BunnySplit)

Installer and antivirus: the LiveSplit overlay no longer needs hlsr-capture.exe, the installer no longer fails on overlay files, and the Injector for Bunnymod XT is switched to a version that Windows Defender does not delete
The FPS limit for Half-Life 2 and Ghosting can now go up to 999
The game settings window no longer closes after “Save”
The home page has a thin scrollbar, and the subscriber frame and the Sponsorship window got a neon glow
Security: launch parameters from foreign files no longer change how the game starts, a “Sign out on all devices” button in the profile settings, 7-Zip updated to 26.05

Demo: finished videos are collected in the Rendered tab, where you can open them, show them in the folder, export again or delete. The player sits in the center, the timeline marks chapters, map changes and the finish, and an HL1 demo series renders as one video

Demo: Advanced settings let you turn on KeyHUD, the game HUD, your config and your HUD. For a long run the launcher suggests rendering the clip right away and shows how long it will take. FFmpeg is offered for download the first time you open the tab
New achievement “Video Editor” for your first saved clip
Ghosting personalization: the ghost and the spray show up in the preview over a blurred game background, with the player model

Mods in personalization: Models and sounds for Half-Life and HUD and models for Ghosting (Condensed HUD also changes the HUD preview, the M9 knife replaces the crowbar). Click a card to turn a mod on, and it goes into the settings code. The mods themselves arrive with game updates
Ghosting: a Vulkan switch in Launch options. The game draws through DXVK, and the LiveSplit overlay still works. Needs Ghosting 1.0.13
LiveSplit overlay: Refresh in the preview also finds a LiveSplit that was not started from the launcher
Config: game settings are gathered in one Game tab
The left panel collapses and pages shift with it. The LiveSplit tab in personalization is marked “in development” for now
Profile settings have a “How to link” tip under Discord that opens on click
Importing a build no longer cancels when your game files are changed: changed programs are replaced with the originals, your own content stays
The Paper theme is brighter: the colors and the green online dot are easy to see
Electron updated to 45.3.0

Sponsorship: a new window. You can support HLSR with a 320 ₽ monthly subscription or a one-time donation, paid through our Telegram bot and Tribute. The window shows subscribers, the “king of the hill” by total donations and everyone who has supported the project; clicking a name opens the profile
Subscribers get a glowing badge next to their name — in the profile, the players list, search and news — and their profile window has a blue outline
Supporters can pick a name highlight and an avatar frame in the profile settings. The same tab shows whether Telegram is linked
When a game crashes, the launcher shows a window with the path to the log: open it in its folder right away and send it to us on Discord

The LiveSplit overlay works in a new way: the game picks it up from its own folder, with no injection into the process. Your own d3d9.dll and opengl32.dll, such as DXVK or ReShade, are never overwritten
HL2 Ghosting no longer crashes a couple of seconds after launch with the overlay on, and games with the overlay no longer crash on exit or on _restart
If a proxy server is turned on in Windows but not responding, the launcher explains how to turn it off instead of showing a cryptic error code
Uninstalling HLSR, including a silent uninstall, now removes the program folder too
Electron is updated to 45.2.0 and the other components to their latest versions

HL1: practice saves now download by themselves. After the game is installed and on every launch, the launcher checks the SAVE folder and fetches the missing saves of the set: e1–e62 and e14-protopipe, loaded with load e1 … load e62. Your own saves with the same names are never overwritten
HL1: if Steam runs in another language, such as Russian, the saves also go to the language folder valve_WON_russian, where the game looks first
HL1: the preview shows the new Bunnymod XT visual settings: the position of the speedometer, jump speed, timer and view angles, jump distance, decimal places, and a hidden or moved weapon
Game menu items such as "Export build" no longer leave white dots at their edges when the cursor sweeps over them quickly
Going to another player's profile opens the profile window anew, so it no longer mixes the data of two profiles
Friends open in place of the profile instead of on top of it
The rating star in the profile sits exactly centred at any interface scale

Windows: Half-Life no longer crashes right after launch on PCs where DEP (Data Execution Prevention) is enforced for all programs. The launcher adds hl.exe to the DEP exceptions by itself, no administrator rights needed. If Windows enforces DEP with no exceptions at all, the crash notification explains how to fix it

"Export build" now saves the whole game into a single .hlsrpack archive: the full folder with cfg files, saves and demos, plus the launcher settings. Carry the archive on a USB stick and install the game from it on another PC without downloading. Build files are checked against a signed list on import, so a tampered archive won't install. Build 5288 from Steam can't be exported whole
The previous lightweight .hlsrbuild export with only settings and cfg files stays in the game menu as "Export settings and cfg". "Import build" accepts both formats
Export and import show their progress on the game card, like a download, and can be cancelled

cfg editor: find and replace (Ctrl+F, Ctrl+H) with match case, whole word and regular expressions, line numbers, go to line (Ctrl+G), commenting, duplicating, deleting and moving lines. All shortcuts are listed in a cheat sheet behind the keyboard button

HL1: new Bunnymod XT visual settings. The speedometer, jump speed, timer and view angles can be moved around the screen, and there are jump distance, decimal places and a wrong FPS warning. The weapon can be hidden, moved, and have its bob tilt and its idle and draw animations turned off. Only commands allowed by the speedrun rules are offered
Linux: when LiveSplit timing is enabled in HL2 Ghosting, the launcher turns on the LiveSplit TCP server itself, so the time reaches the game under Proton
The Discord status no longer disappears if you close the launcher during a game and open it again
Windows: Steam is detected even if the PowerShell folder is missing from the system PATH variable. Before, the launcher then assumed Steam wasn't running
Icons in the profile line up with the text at any interface scale
Game settings, Configs tab: a new "cfg files" section. Every cfg in the build folder can be opened and edited in the launcher without closing the game: after saving, just run exec in the console
Your cfg files no longer revert to the build version: updates, reinstalls and file checks leave edited cfg files alone, while missing ones are still restored

The game menu now has "Export build" and "Import build": game settings and your cfg files travel in a single .hlsrbuild file. If the build isn't installed, the cfg files are placed after it is installed, and for an installed build the launcher checks for an update right away
Binds can be saved and an HL1 config imported while the game is running: there is no need to close it, just run exec hlsr-binds.cfg in the console

HL1: an imported config is placed in the mod folder under its own file names, including subfolders (for example scripts/jump.cfg), and is run from userconfig.cfg. Game files with the same names are kept by the launcher, and "Remove config" restores them. The Scripts tab also finds binds in cfg files from subfolders

HL1: the presets offer the BXT TAS autojump again, which jumps on the first frame on the ground. The plain autojump from 0.4.3 is gone from the list, but one already assigned to a key is still recognized

Interface scale is set on the Interface tab: 75, 100, 125 or 150 %. The window resizes right away, and if it doesn't fit the screen it grows as much as it can. The automatic window enlargement at a system scale below 125 % is gone: if the interface got smaller, pick 125 %

The Home screen has a new Players tab. "Online" shows who is in the launcher right now, with those in a game first and the game named. "Leaderboard" sorts players by hours, achievements, launches, profile rating or join date, and hours and launches can be counted for a single game. Clicking a player opens their profile
Profile settings have a new Privacy section: you can hide yourself from the player lists and not show others what you are playing. Then the list and your profile only say "Online"

Profile rating: you can like or dislike another player's profile (a vote can be changed or removed once every 4 hours), and your own score is shown on your profile. You can like at most 5 different players in 4 hours. Profiles with a strongly negative rating get a "Dubious rating" mark
Your own profile opened from the leaderboard, search or the sponsor list opens as your own: without vote buttons and with the Settings tab

The Sponsors window loads its list from the server and works as king of the hill: whoever supported the project the most is the "Top patron" with a crown in the largest card at the top, 2nd and 3rd place stand below, and the rest share a grid. Large amounts are shortened (100m ₽) and long messages wrap. Clicking a sponsor opens their HLSR profile
Custom badges from the admin panel can be styled: such a badge is drawn in your theme color, like Developer and Verified, and changes along with the theme
Green online dots stay round at any interface scale, and their glow is no longer clipped

Tray: the launcher window comes back 3 seconds after the game closes, and only if the game hasn't been started again. It doesn't take focus from a game that is running, and the one-hour safety return no longer pulls the window over a game
A game that restarts itself (GoldSrc when the video mode changes) is no longer treated as closed: the launcher follows the new process and doesn't pull the window out of the tray
Linux: LiveSplit closed with its own cross or from the menu is now noticed: the overlay detaches, and starting it again no longer answers "already running"
Saving binds or launch options no longer resets the LiveSplit overlay settings

Windows: if your antivirus blocks the downloaded game archive, the launcher now says so and suggests adding the HLSR library folder to its exclusions. Before, a cryptic "UNKNOWN: unknown error" showed up instead

Online features check that the launcher is unmodified. If its files differ from the official build, your sign-in is revoked, online features become unavailable and a "Launcher modified" notification appears: reinstall it from hlsr.pro
Language, hardware acceleration and interface scale no longer overwrite each other when settings are saved
The text on the accent button in the Scripts tab now adapts to the accent color
Linux: if Wine from a different Proton is still running in the game prefix (for example, LiveSplit is open), the launcher warns you instead of starting a game that closes right away
Linux: with Valve Proton builds that lack protonfixes, the launcher explains why fonts can't be installed and suggests Wineland or GE-Proton
Linux: after switching Proton, the prefix is no longer updated again on every launch
Linux: game output is now written to a log and included in the diagnostics archive
Achievement progress is shown without a unit: "16/25" instead of "16/25 h"
The save-load preset in HL1 and HL2 Ghosting is now save x; load x and leaves your quicksave alone
The glow of the Online dot in the game list is no longer clipped
The launcher window is larger: at 100% display scaling the interface now looks the way it used to at 125%
The account menu shows your online status: a green dot when you're online, grey when you're not, plus the game you're playing
The LiveSplit overlay hint no longer sits tight against the edge, and the Refresh button now responds when pressed
Linux: HL2 Ghosting now shows up in Steam as a running game, just like on Windows

When launching LiveSplit you pick the game and its splits. Each game has its own preset splits: HL1 Scripted and Scriptless, HL2 2707 and 4260 With Scripts and Scriptless, HL2 5288 Any% and Any% No Voidclip, by chapter or by map. The splits option is gone from the settings
Splits now actually switch: LiveSplit opens with the chosen splits and layout, and if it's already open with others, the launcher offers to restart it
HL1: chapter splits are triggered automatically through BunnySplit
The LiveSplit overlay only shows in the game LiveSplit was launched for from the launcher
Linux: leaving LiveSplit open after a game no longer makes the launcher think the game is still running
Starting with the next version, the launcher updates in parts: only what changed is downloaded, usually a few megabytes instead of the whole installer
Linux: after an update only the new and the previous launcher versions stay on disk, older ones are removed
Windows: console windows no longer flash after uninstalling HLSR
Game settings can be opened while the game is running

The records feed now covers every speedrun.com category, including miscellaneous ones, and each subcategory separately: Scriptless and Scripted, RTA and SS. Subcategories are labelled under the record, and switching games in the filter animates smoothly
HL1: the autojump preset is now regular BXT autojump while the key is held, not TAS autojump
HL1: script descriptions on the Scripts tab are translated into Russian. The English original opens with the translate icon button
HL1: the Scripts tab finds scripts bound through a chain of aliases
HL1: in Scriptless mode the keyboard flags scripts hidden behind aliases: several commands, wait, +/− aliases, toggles and BXT autojump
HL1: the keyboard shows the player's own config aliases in a separate colour, with the definition in the key card, even when the name matches a guide script
HL1: config import picks up userconfig.cfg and autoexec.cfg, reads UTF-8 with BOM and UTF-16 files from Notepad, and exec config.cfg in the middle of a line no longer loops the game
HL1: the BXT crosshair, HUD colour, BXT panels and FOV from an imported config carry over into personalization, and old launcher overrides on those keys are dropped
HL1: personalization can hide the standard crosshair without the BXT crosshair, and the BXT crosshair gap can be negative
Saving on the Keyboard tab no longer closes the settings window
HL2 Ghosting: the HUD preview follows the screen resolution and aspect ratio, and moved panels sit where they do in the game
Number fields in settings have their own up/down buttons that no longer overlap “px” and “%”. The section list scrollbar is no longer cut off by the corner
Windows: the LiveSplit overlay now shows on AMD graphics where it previously could not hook into the game, such as the integrated Radeon 780M
Windows: HL2 Ghosting and HL2 no longer start blindly without a running Steam: the launcher warns you and offers to open Steam
Windows: after uninstalling HLSR from the installer, Back reopens the installer so HLSR can be installed again
The LiveSplit description on the tools tab covers splits for every game and the overlay, not just Ghosting

Config import on the Keyboard tab: if the config execs other cfg files, the launcher asks you to pick each of them. Exec loops are disabled, identical files are included once, and repeated binds and settings are listed in the report
The Configs tab can now import from a cfg: take sensitivity, volume and other settings from your own config, including files it execs
Half-Life 1: with Steam in Russian, the Configs tab, the keyboard and the scripts now use the settings in valve_WON_russian that the game actually reads
The LiveSplit overlay is sharper: the timer is scaled to its on-screen size in advance instead of being stretched in the game
The crash notification now names the game that crashed instead of always saying HL2 Ghosting
A dump from another program that crashed during the game, such as LiveSplit, is no longer reported as a game crash
Fixed: the update failed to install when HLSR sits right at the root of a drive, for example D:\hlsr
Comments in the standard Half-Life 1 userconfig.cfg are now in English
Half-Life 1: FOV, crosshair and binds set in the launcher are no longer overridden by a large imported config
Half-Life 1: the Gauss door script now restores your FOV and crosshair after the trick, and the Xen scripts restore mouse inversion
LiveSplit overlay: no more green bars on the right and bottom when Windows scaling is above 100%
Linux: fixed the game crashing on its first launch together with LiveSplit
Linux: a fresh install now gets Proton Wineland hlsr3 right away instead of downloading Proton twice
HLSR now runs on Linux too: it installs from an AppImage, games run through Proton, and updates arrive on their own
Windows and Linux share one new installer: pick a folder, cancel the install, and launch HLSR right away
A new main screen: game icons in a column on the left, Home and Games tabs on top, smooth parallax
Eight launcher themes to choose from, from the HLSR signature look to Lambda, Combine and Steam 2003
On first launch the launcher offers Steam sign-in. You can also pick Sign in later, and games launch as usual
Home shows HLSR news and fresh world records from speedrun.com, and records can be filtered by game
News got livelier: screenshots, formatted text and reactions, and records moved to their own tab
Sign in with Steam and get an online profile: status, pronouns, country, and Discord, YouTube and Twitch links
Paste a YouTube or Twitch link however you like: @name, just the name, or the channel address
You can pin your speedrun.com record to your profile
Playtime is now counted by the server from game sessions, so it can't be faked. Hours counted before 0.4 will be deleted
Steam friends, player search by name or SteamID, and online counts for every game
Badges on the profile, and achievements moved to their own tab
New achievements, including A Week at Black Mesa, Marathon and Stopwatch
You can delete your whole profile: you have 7 days to change your mind, then everything is wiped
A new game: Half-Life 1 (WON) with BunnymodXT and RInput
For Half-Life 1: launch options, your own crosshair and HUD, a keyboard with binds, 75 scripts from the guide with videos, and a demos tab
RInput no longer gets in the way of Half-Life 1 menus: clicks land where the cursor is on screen
LiveSplit overlay: the timer shows right in the game window, even in fullscreen. Position, size and OBS-style background keying by colour or brightness are set up in personalization with a preview
Ghosting: the HUD look is set up with a preview right on frames from the game
The Ghosting preview shows weapons more accurately: the frame is picked from neighbouring angles
Share your personalization settings with a single code, and apply someone else's just as quickly
A new Configs tab in game settings: sensitivity, volume and more in plain words instead of variables. Each change goes into your cfg, right where the value is set
If you have no config of your own, Ghosting and Half-Life 1 get the launcher's standard one. The HL1 config already sets the BXT variable that speedrun.com rules require
Linux: game settings take Proton options the way Steam does, for example PROTON_USE_WINED3D=1 mangohud %command%
Linux: Discord shows the map, FPS and run timer in Ghosting, not just In game
One speed limit for all downloads, and any download can be cancelled
Diagnostics are more precise, and hardware acceleration really turns on and off
About now lists the HLSR team, and the main menu has a Sponsors tab
Statistics are only sent after you sign in with Steam and agree to it
Fixed: after moving the library, games launched from the old folder
Fixed: a game crash under Proton sometimes went unnoticed
Fixed: on Linux the game crashed if Steam was not running. Now the launcher warns you and offers to open Steam
Fixed: on Linux the game crashed if the library folder had a neighbour with the same name in a different case (HLSR and hlsr). Now the launcher finds that folder and tells you what to do
Fixed: on Linux SourceSplit did not pick up the game and showed an error if LiveSplit was started first
Fixed: on Linux the delete-save bind did not work in Ghosting and Half-Life 2 (5288)
The LiveSplit icon in the sidebar is now its real logo
Everything inside is updated to fresh versions: Electron 44, Vue 3 and webpack 5, and the launcher itself got lighter
7TV emotes now show up in the Half-Life 2 chat
The launcher goes online for them, not the game: the game sends a word from the chat, the launcher decides whether it is an emote and sends back ready pixels
Emotes are drawn larger than the text, the way Twitch chat does it, and arrive at exactly the size the game draws them - resampled once, in the launcher, instead of twice in a row
Animated emotes are shown as their first frame
Twitch's own emotes are drawn as pictures, animated ones included. The emote id arrives inside the message itself, so there is no list to download
Twitch role badges are drawn before the nick as the real images: broadcaster, moderator, VIP, verified, subscriber and Twitch staff
The badge images ship inside the launcher and nothing goes online for them. If one is missing, a coloured letter is shown instead
YouTube chat added to the in-game chat: messages arrive once a second, nearly as fast as Twitch
YouTube emoji are shown as pictures, like emotes, and no longer merge into one word when written back to back
YouTube role badges: moderator, channel owner, verified and member. Moderator and verified are shown together when someone is both
A person's first message in a channel is marked with a star
The chat is taller and wider, and YouTube emoji are smaller: they were being drawn at emote height, twice the size of the text
Nothing is written to disk: the last few images stay in memory and are fetched again after the game restarts

Fixed: a burst of Twitch messages silenced YouTube chat for the rest of the session. The game was overloading its link to the launcher, the launcher cut it, and the YouTube subscription was never restored afterwards
The game can no longer exceed the launcher's message limit: during an emote flood some requests wait a second instead of costing the whole connection
Fixed: long messages lost their platform marker and role badge — the message did not fit the engine's limit and its tail was cut off

Fixed: after an update the launcher could show an installed game as not installed, and the launch options as reset. When the settings file could not be read (held by an antivirus, say), the launcher decided there were no settings at all and wrote the factory ones in their place. Only people whose library is not on the C: drive ever saw it: for everyone else the substituted path happened to be the real one
Settings that could not be read are no longer overwritten: the launcher retries, and if the file still will not open it runs on defaults without writing them to disk
A settings file that cannot be parsed is set aside with a note in the log instead of being silently replaced
Game names in the list use the same font as the rest of the interface
The first Linux release of HLSR in one AppImage, with the familiar interface.
Games and LiveSplit run through Proton in a shared prefix for the selected game.
HLSR finds Steam and Heroic Proton installations, and custom folders can be added manually.
A verified Proton Wineland is downloaded on first launch; corefonts are installed when a game is first launched.
The game uses Wayland while only LiveSplit uses XWayland in the same prefix; compatible fonts are installed automatically.
The AppImage is built on Ubuntu 24.04 and is never published automatically.
The launcher moved from Electron 18, released in 2022, to 43
The Chromium inside went from 100 to 150: four years of fixes to rendering, animation and memory
A 56 MB component the launcher had long stopped using is gone from the install
The move to a new engine broke nothing in the interface
Ghosting launch options now include a game language choice. Menus, settings and in-game text switch to English or Russian regardless of the Steam language
The «update available» notice no longer hangs around once the update is installed
Hardware acceleration can be switched off in settings, for artefacts and overheating on old graphics drivers
The Discord timer counts time in the app as a whole and no longer resets on map changes, build selection and installs
Demos, screenshots and configs survive a full build update. Previously only what the build description listed by name was kept
Reinstalling Half-Life 2 (5288) no longer wipes saves and settings: for that build, reinstalling is how you repair it
The «Install on exit» button finally installs. It used to show a confirmation and stop there
Libraries needed only to build the launcher itself are gone from the installer
If the update file on the site falls behind what is published next to it, the launcher says so. It used to answer «no updates» in that situation
The diagnostics report no longer carries your Windows user name
Every game now launches with -insecure. Source SDK Base 2013 has no VAC at all, so the flag changes nothing today — it is there in case that stops being true
Windows 7, 8 and 8.1 are no longer supported: the new engine does not run there. Setup will refuse to install and will leave your current launcher untouched
Pressing Install a second time does not start another installer
Updates install where the launcher already lives, not into a guessed folder
If the library path is lost, the launcher finds installed games itself instead of offering to download them again
Ghosting no longer needs Source SDK Base 2013: the engine ships inside the build, so there is no 2.7 GB Steam download
Added a profile: avatar, name, HLSR install date and achievements
There are three achievements to start with: for installing the launcher and for 50 and 163 hours in one game
A summary sits under the achievements: how many are unlocked, total time and the most played game
The profile now has sections, and the SteamID moved next to your name. It is gone from the sidebar
The profile is entirely local: hours and achievements are counted on your computer and never sent anywhere
Settings can export your hours and preferences to an archive, handy before reinstalling Windows
Restoring from an archive is still there, right next to the export
Added a Steam friends list: a plain icon next to your account, press again to close
The friends list is read from Steam files, no developer key needed
Your Steam account shows up right away. No more «Loading profile» placeholder
Started Steam after the launcher? It notices within seconds instead of half a minute
While a game is running the launcher stops polling Steam: fewer hitches during a run
Checking the Steam connection no longer spawns extra processes every half a minute
The launcher now shows an honest playing-now counter
The launcher opens in your system language instead of always in English
«Not enough disk space» finally works: that check used to stay silent on any drive
Changing the library folder in settings applies at once instead of waiting for a restart
Install with a broken path no longer does nothing: it explains why
Update errors are written in plain language instead of raw English technical text
The library path and settings are written so they survive a power cut
An error after startup no longer closes the launcher with a startup error window
The launcher no longer freezes if you start Steam in the middle of installing a build
Half-Life 2 builds do not start downloading until Steam confirms the game is on your account
Before downloading a Half-Life 2 build the launcher explains that the game licence is required and asks first
Updating and repairing Half-Life 2 builds check the licence too, not just the first install
A confirmed licence lasts until Steam restarts, not until the launcher closes
The launcher cleans up links left in the Steam folder by interrupted installs
A build cannot be switched mid-install: one used to download while another was on screen
The «Downloading from Steam» label no longer shows above an ordinary download from the site
Resuming a large download no longer freezes the window while the checksum is recomputed
With Steam closed the launcher stopped polling the system every three seconds
Returning to the launcher window no longer fires three Steam checks at once
The friends panel opens at once: names appear immediately, avatars load right after
Friend avatars show for almost everyone: missing ones come from the public Steam profile page and are kept locally
Profile export and restore explain a refusal in words instead of a code
Diagnostics gained a «Profile and statistics» section: it shows why hours are not adding up
Steam running as administrator is finally detected: in 0.3.12 that check never worked
The restart-as-administrator button now shows up when launching Half-Life 2 too
Declining the elevation prompt no longer closes the launcher
The sidebar shows your Steam account: avatar, name and SteamID
Click the Steam account to hide the SteamID, copy it or open the profile
The launcher hides to tray while you play and comes back when the game closes
Update notifications name the actual game again
The notification about picking a build is gone
The sidebar now has Games and Tools tabs
The LiveSplit timer installs straight from the launcher, with ready splits
Which splits the timer opens with is picked in the launcher settings
Half-Life 2 2707 starts again: the build itself kept rewriting steam_appid.txt
The Half-Life 2 config folder is found for every build, not just 4260
The tray icon stopped going missing in the packaged launcher
Steam running as administrator is no longer reported as "Steam is not running"
The launcher restarts as administrator with one button
Installing a build reports once instead of three separate entries
Notifications name the actual game instead of labelling everything as Ghosting
Diagnostics show the Steam path, process id and how it was identified
The "Verify files" item is gone, repair stays
Every game now requires launcher 0.3.9 or newer
Player settings are no longer reported as damaged files

File verification and repair are off for now while we rework them

The build descriptor comes from the signed channel, not the bundled copy
A release will not sign a descriptor belonging to another version
Half-Life 2 arrived, with an engine build selector: 4260, 2707 and 5288
Builds 4260 and 2707 download from our hosting, 5288 comes from Steam depots
Before launching Half-Life 2 the launcher checks the game is on your Steam account
Half-Life 2 saves, configs and screenshots are no longer treated as build files
Switching a build refreshes the game card at once: version, state and the button
Steam downloads are labelled separately and count files instead of megabytes
Diagnostics report whether Half-Life 2 is on the Steam account
Switching games mid-download no longer says "Installation complete"
For build 5288 verify and repair are off in the menu: Steam handles them
Half-Life 2 appeared in the game list, its builds are on the way
The game list is split: available games on top, upcoming ones below the divider

Opposing Force and Blue Shift are out of the plans
Launch options gained -dx9, -nocrashdialog, -noasync, -noaafonts and -high
The game can be kept off CPU 0, with the mask derived from the core count
The Ghosts tab shows for Ghosting only
The update history shows every release as its own entry

A patch is built from any released version straight to the new one
Skipped a release? You will not be downloading the whole build again
